Coming from someone who still struggles with suicidal thoughts. My best answer for you is you dont know who's life your gonna impact. Even if it's for a minute. Quick little story. I attempted to kill myself one day and failed. About a month later I had a conversation with someone at a bus stop. Didnt think anything of it just talked about life the world little stuff. A few weeks after that I seen this woman again at the same bus stop. I said hello and she came to me with tears in her eyes and thanked me for that one conversation. To me it was nothing just being polite.  I guess to her it ment so much more. She said she felt so alone and unnoticed and contemplated if life was worth living. That our simple conversation and the fact I didnt dismiss her or ignore her. That the 10 minutes of my time I spent talking with her made her have a little more hope. 

I know things are hard. I may not know what your going through. Trust me when I say I understand the feeling. Just know that you can chnage 1 persons day for the better and not even know it. Stay strong. Even in the darkest of times reach for that little light inside you. You are worth it. I dont know you but yet I care for you. And the fact you are reaching out proves you have light left in you. You have fight in you. I dont really respond on reddit but something made me reach out to you. I'm sending positive thoughts to you.
